name: mockpit
description: Publish design mocks (states, variants, asks, knobs) to mockpit over MCP, and stream the user's batched replies back to Claude Code as notifications.

mockpitUrl.title: Mockpit URL
mockpitUrl.description: Base URL of your mockpit server. Local default is http://localhost:8228; set your deployed instance (e.g. https://mockpit.you.workers.dev) otherwise.

apiToken.title: Mockpit token
apiToken.description: Bearer token for a deployed mockpit instance. Leave blank for a local server.
